title: Module Assessment: Type Hinting (PY_237 to PY_243)

slides.title: Module 6 Overview
slides.prompt: Assessment covering Python Type Annotations, the `typing` module, mypy static analysis, Generics, Protocols, and Duck Typing.
slides.codeSnippet:
def greeting(name: str) -> str:
    return f'Hello {name}'

slides.title: Question 1: Runtime Behavior
slides.prompt: How do Type Hints affect Python code execution at runtime?
options: They have no effect; they are ignored by the Python runtime interpreter
They make the execution significantly faster
They raise a TypeError if a wrong type is passed
They automatically cast variables to the specified type
slides.correctAnswer: They have no effect; they are ignored by the Python runtime interpreter

slides.title: Question 2: Return Type Syntax
slides.prompt: Fill in the symbol used to denote the return type of a function.
slides.codeSnippet:
def add(x: int, y: int) ___ int:
    return x + y

slides.title: Question 3: Optional Types
options: The value can be either a string or None
The argument is not required and can be omitted
slides.correctAnswer: The value can be either a string or None

slides.title: Question 4: Union Operator (Python 3.10+)
slides.prompt: In modern Python (3.10+), what is the concise alternative syntax for `Union[int, float]`?

slides.title: Question 5: Static Checker
slides.prompt: Fill in the name of the most popular static type checker tool used to validate Python type hints.

slides.title: Question 6: Any Type
options: When a value can be of any arbitrary type, disabling type checking for it
As a default return type for all functions
slides.correctAnswer: When a value can be of any arbitrary type, disabling type checking for it

slides.title: Question 7: Callable Types
slides.prompt: How would you type-hint a parameter `cb` that accepts a function taking an `int` and returning a `str`?

slides.title: Question 8: Type Aliases
slides.prompt: Fill in the syntax to create a Type Alias for a complex type.

slides.title: Question 9: Generics
slides.prompt: Which tool from the `typing` module is used to create Generic types that enforce consistency across arguments?

slides.title: Question 10: Structural Subtyping
slides.prompt: Which `typing` class is used to define an interface for Duck Typing (Structural Subtyping) without requiring explicit inheritance?

slides.title: Question 11: No Return
slides.prompt: Fill in the type hint used to indicate that a function unconditionally raises an exception or runs forever.

slides.title: Question 12: Literal Types
options: The value must be exactly the string 'r' or 'w'
The value must be a string containing 'r' and 'w'
The value is a regular expression
slides.correctAnswer: The value must be exactly the string 'r' or 'w'

slides.title: Question 13: Class Variables
slides.prompt: How do you distinguish a class variable from an instance variable when type hinting?

slides.title: Question 14: Runtime Inspection
slides.prompt: Which function from the `typing` module allows inspection of evaluated type hints at runtime?
